Together (2025)
This isn’t your typical romance. It’s the grossest yet most insanely romantic film of the year , where “two become one” takes on a spine-shredding, body-horror twist. What starts as a move to the countryside becomes an underground nightmare of fused limbs, desperate love and the terror of losing yourself for someone else. This film doesn’t just test the boundaries of relationships, it rips them apart and stitches them back together, both emotionally and physically. It’s a love story that asks: how much of yourself would you give up to stay together?

The film was shot in just 21 days.  The real-life couple starring Dave Franco and Alison Brie endured hours in prosthetics that fused their arms together, making the physicality of their horror deeply tangible. The physical pain and discomfort weren’t just acting , they were part of the performance. Every struggle, every breath, every scream is 100% authentic.

source_details.synopsis: Together is a 2025 supernatural body horror film written and directed by Michael Shanks in his feature-length directorial debut. It stars Dave Franco and Alison Brie as a couple who move to the countryside, where they are afflicted with a horrific curse. The film's supernatural element is loosely based on the Greek myth of Hermaphroditus and the fountain of Salmacis. A co-production between Australia and the United States, Together premiered at Sundance on January 26, 2025, and was released in the United States by Neon on July 30 and in Australia by Kismet Movies on July 31.
